style: short selling momentum exhaustion on low-float small caps

setup.rule: first red day after multi-day runner
setup.quote: the first red day that you continue to trade

entry.rule: wait for stock to go red then attack
entry.quote: You cannot anticipate the move. You have to wait for it to go red and then attack it

stop.rule: max loss auto liquidation at 2 days average P&L
stop.quote: Your max loss auto liquidation should be no more than two days worth of your trading

exits.rule: add to winner on confirmation signals like break VWAP or low of day
exits.quote: If the stock then breaks VWAP, I will get to 50% of my size. If the stock then breaks low of the day, I'll get to 75% of my size

sizing.rule: scale in only on proven right signals, max 30% size above VWAP
sizing.quote: if a stock is above VWAP, the volume weighted average price, I am not allowed to use more than 30% of my max size

market_filter.rule: only aggressive on A+ setups once or twice a year
market_filter.quote: perfect opportunities happen once or twice a year
